newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Promet sells 22 mln rgt worth of land.
newsitem.headline: Promet sells 22 mln rgt worth of land.

text.p: Malaysian marine engineer and constructor Promet Bhd said on Tuesday it plans to sell three pieces of land in the southern state of Johor to MBf Property Services Sdn Bhd for a total of 22 million ringgit.
The sale would be paid for by cash, Promet said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.

"The disposal of the said lands is part of the company's continuing rationalisation exercise to move away from property development and investment, and to concentrate on Promet's activities in the infrastructure, engineering and gas construction areas," Promet said.
The company said the sale would result in an extraordinary gain of around 19.07 million ringgit.
